name: PreviewTrigger
summary: Shows delayed preview content while a trigger is hovered or focused.

useWhen: Showing a lightweight preview before navigation
Adding detail to an item that stays usable without it
avoidWhen: Content the user needs to continue; keep it in the page
Critical actions requiring confirmation; use AlertDialog
Content that opens on a press and stays open; use Popover

obligations: Open from pointer, touch long press, and keyboard focus.
Allow interactive preview content to remain reachable without trapping focus.

behavior: The preview opens after a hover delay, on touch long press, and on keyboard focus.
The pointer can move from the trigger onto the preview without closing it.
Open state is controlled with open and onOpenChange, or starts from defaultOpen when uncontrolled.
placement accepts top, bottom, start, end, top-start, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-end, start-top, start-bottom, end-top, and end-bottom.
start and end resolve through the current locale direction.
An unsupported placement, a non-finite offset or crossOffset, a non-boolean shouldFlip, or a negative or non-finite containerPadding throws a TypeError.
Keep the muxui-preview-trigger and muxui-preview-content selectors and the placement and transition state attributes for consumer styling.
With disabled set, the preview does not open, and an open one closes.
The trigger stays operable: disabled adds no aria-disabled or data-disabled to it.
accessibility: Require a focusable trigger and an accessible name for the interactive preview.
Expose dialog semantics without focus containment so the trigger and preview remain reachable.
Focus stays on the trigger when the preview opens.
Tab moves focus into the preview when the preview contains focusable content.
Escape closes the preview and returns focus to the trigger.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
